A book is primarily made of paper, ink, and binding materials such as glue or thread.

Regarding the text provided: "The committee has finished its work, and they have submitted its report to the board."

There is a pronoun-antecedent agreement error in the second clause. The antecedent "committee" is a collective noun. In the first clause, it is treated as singular ("its work"). In the second clause, the pronoun "they" treats it as plural, while "its" treats it as singular. To maintain consistency and correct agreement, you should choose either singular or plural for the entire sentence.

Correction (Singular):
The committee has finished its work, and it has submitted its report to the board.

Correction (Plural):
The committee have finished their work, and they have submitted their report to the board.
